en: Black-and-white interior view of a historic church with rows of wooden pews leading toward an ornate altar and altarpiece. A large chandelier hangs from the vaulted ceiling. To the left is a richly carved pulpit, and on the right a decorated gallery or memorial plaque. The image bears printed Swedish text at the top reading "Arboga Landsförsamlings kyrka." Handwritten numbers appear faintly above the altar area.
